promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a cozy cream-and-mint room backdrop with tiny furniture; the glyph is deep-teal 間: the 門 frame with a 日 box between its doors. A wind-up animal band with a bear drummer, a duck trumpeter and a mouse cymbal player. The Traditional Chinese glyph 間 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the band tiptoes in; the duck's trumpet honks and the bear's drum rolls off; the first 間 is spoken at the honk. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the cymbal clatters, tipping the 門 posts upright; the drum rolls under and nudges the 日 box into the gap; the second 間 is spoken as it lands. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): the mouse flips a tiny desk lamp on and a toy bed, sofa and rug pop up in the glow; 房間 is spoken as the lamp clicks on. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 間 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the band struts in place, clapping tiny cymbals. Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, reading exactly these syllables with clear tones and no erhua: 「間、間、房間」 (ㄐㄧㄢ、ㄐㄧㄢ、ㄈㄤˊ ㄐㄧㄢ). Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.5s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only honks, drum rolls and cymbal clinks, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
